game_title: Fallback: Boolean Circuit – Crater Lake Edge
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the fire warden must hold off molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the cooling vent.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the cooling vent. Then check power_on and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cooling vent from molten golems in Crater Lake Edge: keep power_on above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 6, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
